_comment: ROM library for the web debugger. Every entry is open source; `file` is served from web/roms/ (populated by web/fetch-roms.py, which also verifies `sha256`). Entries with `fixture` are copied from this repository; the rest are downloaded from the author's GitHub release or, when there is none, from a pinned commit of the gbadev Homebrew Hub database (github.com/gbadev-org/games).

roms.title: Dungeon Master
roms.author: Maksim Jaroslavcevas (Maksasj)
roms.note: Rogue-like written in C with devkitadv.

roms.title: CASCADE7
roms.author: Mick Schroeder
roms.note: Drop7-style puzzle game built with Butano. The CASCADE7 name and logo are trademarks of Mick Schroeder, LLC.
